findings.title: OptimizedCursorPaginator fails with TypeError when sorting by datetime fields
findings.body: OrganizationAuditLogsEndpoint configures OptimizedCursorPaginator with order_by="-datetime", where AuditLogEntry.datetime is a datetime.datetime instance. However, OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_item_key calls math.floor(value) / math.ceil(value) directly on getattr(item, self.key), which raises TypeError: must be real number, not datetime.datetime as soon as any audit log row is processed. Additionally, value_from_cursor returns the raw numeric cursor.value instead of converting it back to a timezone-aware datetime object (as DateTimePaginator does), which causes subsequent cursor queries to compare a timestamp column against a number.

findings.title: Passing negative offsets to Django QuerySet slicing raises unhandled ValueError
findings.body: Both BasePaginator.get_result (line 182, when cursor.is_prev is True) and OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_result (lines 877-886, when enable_advanced_features is True or cursor.is_prev is True) pass negative cursor.offset values directly into queryset[start_offset:stop]. Contrary to the inline comments, Django's QuerySet.__getitem__ does not support negative slice bounds and immediately raises ValueError("Negative indexing is not supported."). Any request supplying a cursor with a negative offset (e.g., cursor=0:-1:1) will trigger an unhandled 500 Internal Server Error instead of clamping the offset or raising BadPaginationError.

findings.title: Unchecked access to organization_context.member raises AttributeError for token requests
findings.body: Line 71 evaluates request.user.is_superuser or organization_context.member.has_global_access on every GET request. When the endpoint is accessed via an organization API token (or any non-superuser principal without an associated OrganizationMember record), organization_context.member is None and this line raises AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'has_global_access', breaking the endpoint even when optimized_pagination is not requested.

findings.title: Incorrect length check prevents trimming the extra row when offset is non-zero
findings.body: In OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_result, queryset[start_offset:stop] is sliced with stop = start_offset + limit + extra, so results can contain at most limit + extra items. Line 891 checks elif len(results) == offset + limit + extra:, which can never be true whenever offset != 0, leaving an extra unrequested item in the page results when paginating backward with a non-zero offset.
